title: Labour welfare fund due days
description: The days of every year by which an employer pays a State's labour welfare fund both contributions, or submits the statement of them, as the State's Act or rules set them from 1 April 2026, before the day or on or before it as the instrument writes it, with the register each day is for where the instrument names one; a day falls after that register day, in the next year when the register closes the year. Goa's rules set days for the half-yearly statements and none for paying, and Haryana's Act one day a year for its monthly contributions. One-off extensions of these days are not held here. A State without a row is one whose days the ERP has not read, never a finding that nothing falls due. The set answers for the last day of a contribution period, the day the register fixes who is counted.

Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund Rules, 1953, rule 3-A, inserted by Government Notification of 4 May 1971, its day of July as notification No. MLW-1161/157706-Lab. iii-B, 18 August 1973, sets it
Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1953 (Mah. XL of 1953), section 6BB(3), inserted by Mah. 16 of 1971
